gpt.text:
Run the three commands in order; they cover (1) module-level search and promotion, (2) system-level candidate evaluation, and (3) generating a prioritized fix list based on the latest results.

## 1) Module autopilot: try to produce a PASS and/or select a new best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What to watch for:
- Whether it produces any **PASS candidates** (you currently have none).
- Whether it **replaces the champion** (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`) or keeps it.
- Any regressions in:
  - `tuning_mean/min` (currently ~1.904 / 0.431)
  - `lockbox_mean/min` (currently ~1.793 / 1.134)

If it “selects best” but results look marginal/noisy, re-run once to confirm stability before accepting.

## 2) System autopilot: evaluate system-level candidates
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What to watch for:
- Any candidate that improves **both** tuning and lockbox (or improves one without meaningfully harming the other).
- Any failure mode that appears only at system integration (common when module-level looks fine).

If this produces “INCONCLUSIVE” outcomes, capture variance: re-run the same spec with fixed seeds (if supported) or multiple trials.

## 3) Generate next prioritized fix list
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
This is your “what to fix next” plan. Use it after (1) and (2) so it incorporates the newest run metadata.

## Quick sanity checks before/after running
- Confirm `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` is committed/tagged so promotions are traceable.
- Ensure the run artifacts/logs directory is not being overwritten unexpectedly (if your tooling uses a default output path).
- If you see a new best: compare deltas against the champion, and verify the **min** metrics didn’t collapse (mins often reveal brittleness).

If you paste the autopilot outputs (or the summary table), I can help decide whether any candidate should be promoted and what the next-fix report implies.
